## How was it tested?

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes in `frontend/` (and `backend/` when touched)
- [ ] `npm test` passes in `frontend/` (and `backend/` when touched)
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes in `frontend/`
- [ ] New behavior has tests; bug fixes have a test that fails without the fix

## Honest-labels checklist (UI changes)

- [ ] Anything simulated is labeled as simulated in the UI
- [ ] Status states (connected / demo / unavailable) tell the truth
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, or secrets appear in code, logs, or screenshots
